title: Literal evaluation criterion
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a literal specify a coordinate $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and a required sign $s\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{n}$ be a sign vector. The literal evaluates to $-1$ exactly when $x_i=s$.
hypotheses_covered: A literal with coordinate $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ and required sign $s\in\{-1,1\}$
